verdicts.observation: Bearded figure stays on a white card; prev and burst look nearly identical, and the text '13th' appears to the right by +3 and extends to '13th century' by +8.
Figure is static on white; the handwritten text grows letter by letter from '13th' to '13th c' to '13th century'.
Pale blank background shifts to a sky-and-desert scene while the figure shrinks and drops lower; consistent with a reframe/zoom-out, though the background change could also be a fade.
Same desert scene; figure moves slightly and the horizon and sky shift across the 4 frames, like a small pan or scale.
Globe with figures shifts position and then shrinks while text begins to slide in from the right; frames are sparse.
Globe shrinks and slides left while the 'Estimated deaths: 40 million' text slides in from behind it.
Globe continues to shrink and shift left as the text settles into place beside it.
Globe and text make a small settling movement and then hold; only a minor reposition is visible.
Globe plus 'Estimated deaths: 40 million' is replaced in one frame by a '2. The Black Death / Survival chance 7%' title card.
Volcano on a zoomed globe cross-dissolves to the globe without the volcano, and by +8 a fiery cracked planet sits on white.
Zoomed globe view shifts and pans in the burst frame, then at +3 and +8 it is replaced by a small fiery planet on white (large reframe; the transition type in between is not visible).
Fiery planet on white shrinks and moves slightly across the 4 frames.
Fiery planet shrinks and drifts slightly right on white.
The wasteland picture on the chalkboard fades and collapses to a thin strip, then a mammoth picture fades in at +3 and +8.
The mammoth image grows from a faint, small strip to a full-opacity larger picture across the frames, like a fade or scale in.
Mammoth picture looks essentially unchanged across the four frames; only the character's mouth and eyes vary slightly.
Mammoth picture shrinks and fades at the burst, the board is empty at +3, and a sea picture appears at +8.
Sea picture grows from faint and small to full opacity and size on the chalkboard.
Burst frame looks the same as prev (sea picture); the picture later fades to a strip and a dead-tree picture appears by +8, so the burst timing is ambiguous.
Sea picture shrinks into a thin strip and cross-fades into a dead-tree landscape by +3 and +8.
Dead-tree picture grows from a faint small strip to full size and opacity on the chalkboard.
Red rectangle and '3000' text slide left and out of frame; the card is empty by +3 and the edge of a crowd blob enters from the right at +8.
A crowd-of-figures blob slides in from the right edge toward center on a white background.
The crowd blob continues moving left from the right side and settles near center-right.
The crowd blob moves leftward to center and then holds at the right-center position.
The crowd blob appears to finish a slide and settle toward the right; movement is small and the frames are sparse.
An isometric corn-field icon slides from left to right across the white card and moves down.
A mammoth exits toward the bottom-left, the card is empty at +3, and a sun appears at the top right by +8.
A sun icon drops in from the top and settles lower on the white card.
The sun icon settles into position, moving slightly down and across the frames.
The 'no second chances' text card is replaced by a different card showing the bearded character with a leaf skirt.
Classroom with 'subscribe' on the chalkboard; the view is slowly shifting and zooming in on the character.
Zoom or pan in on the classroom: the board text moves left and out, and the character and poster grow larger.
The view keeps zooming in: 'subscribe' slides off-left while the character's face grows.
A close zoom on the face continues as the last letters of 'subscribe' leave the frame.
Camera framing is near-static on a close-up face; only the eye and glasses positions and the mouth change slightly.
The close-up face zooms out to a wide classroom view with 'subscribe' on the chalkboard.
Wide classroom with 'subscribe'; the framing shifts and scales slightly across the 4 frames.
